correct_ahj: City and County of Denver — Community Planning and Development, Development Services (coordinating DDPHE, SUDP, and fire reviews)
job_type: Convert a vacant retail tenant suite inside Denver city limits into a new full-service restaurant through an extensive interior remodel: new commercial cooking line and Type I hood, hood fire-suppression system, grease interceptor, new sinks and plumbing, new HVAC/hood exhaust, and new electrical branch circuits; change the primary use to an eating-and-drinking establishment; no alcohol service, no exterior work, no outdoor seating, and the property is not a landmark or in a historic district.

supports: All Denver businesses require a zoning use permit.
Virtually all restaurant and commercial-kitchen projects need building permits and inspections.
Major restaurant projects include building, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, public-health, sewer-use-and-drainage, and fire reviews.
DDPHE performs full plan review for a change of use or extensive remodel, and SUDP reviews food-service pretreatment/grease-interceptor scope.
Submitting the building-log application in E-permits starts the coordinated reviews; zoning and building may be submitted concurrently.
Identifies Denver Community Planning and Development/Development Services as the permitting workflow owner.
